about_the_game:
Strip Miner takes the relaxing game loop of sandbox strip mining and distills it into a casual roguelike mining experience.

You start every run just below the surface of a massive corporate drill shaft, armed with only a corporate-issued mining tool. Mine ores, haul them back, and deposit them to afford upgrades: faster mining speed, increased mining strength, or even some additional emergency tools like explosives or rope.

Don’t forget the company quota. To descend deeper into the shells of rock, you must prove your worth to your creator by reaching quota. Fail, and you are forgotten. Succeed, and you receive a replenished corporate-issued tool, because only the best bots may continue digging.

Each layer brings harder rock and new hazardous environments. Whether you’re chasing depth, profit, or just trying to survive one more layer, Strip Miner offers a gritty, endless descent.

Wanna dig with no constraints? Try Infinite Mode: a sandbox-style option granted to you for being the best mining bot, with no corporate quotas or limited tool usage. Just you and the mines you yearn for.
